# Shafiq Rahman - Fractional CIO & Executive Advisory

> Executive technology leadership, enterprise AI governance (NIST AI RMF), healthcare IT (Epic EHR / HIPAA), and higher education technology advisory led by former State CIO Shafiq Rahman, MS, MBA, MCS, PMP®.

Nexis AI provides elite Fractional CIO, interim executive leadership, and board technology governance based in Howard County, Maryland, serving clients across the United States, Europe, and global regions.
